question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sustain
solution:
The correct answer is “**Obstruct**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• "**Sustain**" generally means to strengthen or support physically or mentally, or to keep something going over time or continuously. (संभालना)

 
 
• **Example**- Her determination sustained her through difficult times.
 
 
 
• "**Obstruct**" refers to blocking something or being in the way of progress or achievement, which is the opposite to "Sustain". (अवरोध करना)
 
 
• **Example**- The road was obstructed by a fallen tree.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "Obstruct".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• "**Embrace**" generally means to accept something willingly and enthusiastically. (ग्रहण करना)
 
• "**Rectify**" is used when someone corrects or fixes something. (सुधारना)
 
• "**Continue**" describes maintaining a particular condition, situation, course of action, etc., without interruption. (जारी रखना)
